rules.comparison_prefix: all five command substeps strictly precede the first physical violation
rules.force_prefix: completed internal samples strictly before the first physical violation
rules.retrieval_neighbors: actual proposed expert's recorded cases, including shuffled roles
rules.unscored: no actual-expert prediction, no proposal, disabled, or no comparable previous action
rules.previous_action: prior resolved final canonical command from adjacent raw rows, never raw proposal
rules.provider_history_after_step_one: empty in the tested host; prior-command differences are audit-only observations
rules.omitted_differences: maximum absolute coordinate difference per named field and case neighbor
rules.phase_difference: maximum circular difference of the exact four clocked phase steps
